description: This source file implements filesystem-related functionalities for the Battle for Wesnoth project, including directory management, file reading/writing, directory traversal, and integration with zip collections.

classes.name: file_tree_checksum
classes.description: Represents a checksum of a file tree, including number of files, total size, and last modification time.

classes.name: binary_paths_manager
classes.description: Manages binary search paths based on configuration.

classes.name: scoped_istream
classes.description: A RAII wrapper for std::istream pointers, ensuring proper cleanup.

classes.name: scoped_ostream
classes.description: A RAII wrapper for std::ostream pointers, ensuring proper cleanup.

methods.name: filesystem_init
methods.description: Initializes the filesystem, including zip collection if enabled.

methods.description: Returns the path to the preferences file.

methods.name: get_save_index_file
methods.description: Returns the path to the save index file.

methods.name: get_saves_dir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for saves.

methods.name: get_cache_dir
methods.description: Returns the cache directory path.

methods.name: get_intl_dir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for internationalization files.

methods.name: get_screenshot_dir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for screenshots.

methods.description: Returns the current working directory.

methods.name: get_user_data_dir

methods.description: Reads all data from standard input.

methods.name: istream_file

methods.name: read_file
methods.description: Reads entire content of a file into a string.

methods.name: write_file

methods.name: read_map
methods.description: Reads map data from multiple possible locations.

methods.description: Checks if a path is a directory, considering zip collections.

methods.name: file_exists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists.

methods.name: file_create_time
